title: tokenpage
description:
This repository is tokenizer research for agent-to-agent traffic. It asks what the tokenizer vocabulary should look like when most of the text is agents talking to agents.

It plans measurements of how current vocabularies tokenize that traffic, experiments on open-weight models, and reproducible benchmarks.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
